full_prompt_en: A square oil painting shows a close group of young dancers seated in a rehearsal room. The most prominent figure sits slightly left of center, wearing a deep emerald bodice with sheer sleeves and a pale cream skirt. A narrow teal ribbon is tied in her reddish-brown hair. She rests her chin lightly near her right hand, looking toward the right with a tired, inward expression. Beside her at the right, another dancer in faded sea-green and yellow leans forward with her eyes lowered. A partial profile enters from the far left, and several more figures appear behind them as loosely painted heads and shoulders. A wide ocher wall and a dark wooden rail run behind the seated group; a brown vessel and small items rest along it. The composition crops the foreground figures closely, making their hands, shoulders, and expressions more important than the full room. Warm mustard wall tones contrast with cool green costumes, pale skin, and muted lavender-gray skirts. Faces are drawn with careful, soft modeling, while garments and background are worked in freer, broken strokes. The brushwork preserves the grain of paint and small shifts in color rather than rendering every edge sharply. Light is diffuse and indoor, falling softly across cheeks and fabric without a theatrical spotlight. There is no stage, performance gesture, signage, or readable text. The mood is quietly observational: the dancers seem between activities, absorbed in thought, while the crowded arrangement still has an elegant rhythm of repeated tilted heads and elbows.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形油画呈现一群年轻舞者坐在排练室休息。最醒目的人物略偏左，穿深翡翠绿紧身上衣、半透袖和浅奶油色裙，红棕发上系一条窄青绿色带。她右手轻轻靠近下巴，疲倦而内省地望向右侧。右边另一位身着褪色海绿与黄色的舞者前倾、垂目。画面最左有局部侧脸，后方另有数人以松散绘出的头肩出现。宽阔赭黄墙面和深木横杆在坐着的人群后延伸；栏上放着棕色容器和小物。构图紧密裁切前景人物，使手、肩和神情比完整房间更重要。暖芥末黄墙色对比冷绿服装、浅肤色和低调薰衣草灰裙。面部以细致柔和塑形，衣物与背景则用更自由断续的笔触。笔触保留油彩颗粒和细微色彩变化，而非每处边缘都刻得锋利。漫散室内光轻落脸颊和布料，没有舞台聚光。没有舞台、表演姿态、标牌或可读文字。氛围安静且具观察性：舞者像处于活动间隙，沉浸在思绪里，而拥挤安排仍有倾斜头部与手肘重复的优雅节律。
style_prompt_en: Use intimate observational oil painting with carefully modeled focal areas and freer broken strokes around them. Pair warm ocher and mustard grounds with cool emerald, sea-green, pale cream, and lavender-gray passages. Let diffuse indoor light reveal soft transitions across rounded forms while preserving visible brush grain in broad fabric and background areas. Compose a closely cropped cluster with overlapping silhouettes and a rhythm of tilted shapes and bent lines. Avoid theatrical spotlights or uniformly polished finish. Edges should alternate between crisp at focal expressions or gestures and soft where neighboring forms merge. The atmosphere is quiet and psychologically attentive, finding elegance in an unposed pause.
style_prompt_zh: 采用亲近的观察性油画，在焦点区域细致塑形，在周围使用更自由的断续笔触。以暖赭黄和芥末黄底色搭配冷翡翠绿、海绿、淡奶油色和薰衣草灰色段落。漫散室内光揭示圆润形体上的柔软过渡，同时让大片布面与背景保留可见画笔颗粒。紧密裁切相互叠合的形体群，建立倾斜形和弯折线的节律。避免戏剧性聚光或统一抛光的完成度。边缘在焦点表情或姿势处清楚，在相邻形体交融处柔化。氛围安静、关注内在状态，从未经摆拍的停顿中发现优雅。
theme_en: Young dancers resting along the wall of a rehearsal room
theme_zh: 排练室墙边休息的年轻舞者
name: Edgar Degas
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
